Build Sprint 12 — Reporting, admin panel completion, EU REACH ink passports, hardening, launch readiness. This is the FINAL sprint. Working dir: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`.

**Plan reference:** `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` Sprint 12 section.
**All prior sprints (0-11) are complete.** This sprint polishes, completes admin, adds reporting, and hardens for launch.

**Sprint 12 scope:**

### 1. REPORTING (all authed, owner/admin)

Create `/reports` page with tabs:

**Revenue dashboard** at `/reports/revenue`:
- Line chart: revenue over time (daily/weekly/monthly toggle, date range picker)
- KPIs: total revenue, avg session value, deposits collected, tips, MRR from subscriptions
- Revenue by artist bar chart
- Revenue by service pie/donut chart
- Revenue by location (if multi-location)
- YoY comparison (if data exists)
- CSV export all data
- Use recharts or chart.js (whichever is already installed from Sprint 2 calendar area — check `package.json`). If neither, install `recharts`.

**Artist performance** at `/reports/artists`:
- Leaderboard: revenue generated, sessions completed, avg tip %, no-show rate
- Artist comparison chart (selected artists side-by-side)
- Trend lines per artist over last 6 months

**Client analytics** at `/reports/clients`:
- Retention cohort chart (month-over-month rebooking %)
- New vs returning client split
- Client lifetime value distribution
- Churn analysis (inactive >90d trend)
- Top spending clients

**Booking analytics** at `/reports/bookings`:
- Bookings over time
- No-show rate trend (before/after reminders impact)
- Popular times heatmap (day of week × hour)
- Service popularity ranking
- Booking source breakdown (internal/public/waitlist)
- Cancellation rate + reasons

**Inventory reports** at `/reports/inventory`:
- COGS per session
- Supply spend trends
- Stock turnover rate
- Low stock frequency

**AI usage** at `/reports/ai`:
- Generations this month vs quota
- Cost breakdown by model (Claude vs image gen)
- Most-used styles
- Average generation rating

**Implementation approach:**
- API routes: `/api/reports/revenue`, `/api/reports/artists`, `/api/reports/clients`, `/api/reports/bookings`, `/api/reports/inventory`, `/api/reports/ai`. Each accepts `{from, to, group_by}` params. Return aggregated data shapes.
- Charts: install `recharts` if not present. All charts use `ResponsiveContainer` + dark theme colors matching brand tokens.
- Export: PDF + CSV per report section.
- Cache: heavy queries use `unstable_cache` with 5-min TTL (or use React `cache()` per-request if too stale). Reports are read-only.

### 2. ADMIN PANEL COMPLETION

Flesh out the admin panel at `/admin/*` (platform_admin only, service-role queries):

**`/admin` dashboard** — Real KPIs:
- Total studios, total artists, total bookings (all-time), total revenue (GMV)
- MRR, ARR, monthly churn rate, trial conversion rate
- New signups chart (last 30 days)
- Active studios (>1 booking last 7 days) count

**`/admin/studios`** — Studio management:
- Search + filter (plan, status, signup date, country)
- Impersonate: "Login as studio" → generates a short-lived auth token for the studio owner (logs to audit_log). Use `supabase.auth.admin.generateLink({type: 'magiclink'})` approach.
- Ban/Unban: sets `studios.status = 'banned'` (add column if needed)
- GDPR export: download all data for a studio as JSON zip
- Delete studio: dangerous action with type-confirm ("type STUDIO_NAME to confirm")

**`/admin/billing`** — already partially built (Sprint 4). Enrich:
- MRR breakdown by plan tier (Solo/Studio/Pro/Enterprise × monthly/annual)
- Churn cohort: studios that cancelled this month vs last
- Failed payment retry queue
- Subscription list sortable by MRR contribution

**`/admin/ai-usage`** — already built (Sprint 9). Add: cost graph over time, top 10 studios by cost.

**`/admin/system`** — System health:
- Audit log search (actor, action, target, date range)
- Webhook events log (source, status, retry count)
- Error log (from Sentry via API if available, else just recent webhook failures)
- Feature flags management: create/toggle/expire flags per studio
- System announcements: create banners shown to all studios

### 3. EU REACH INK PASSPORT

Bring the REACH ink records (created Sprint 5, extended Sprint 10) to full product:

- `/settings/ink-registry` page: studio maintains approved inks list with REACH compliance data (brand, color, batch, manufacture date, expiry, SDS URL, REACH status).
- On consent form with REACH section: auto-populate from registry when artist selects inks used.
- Per-session ink usage report: from booking detail, link to REACH records via `reach_ink_records`.
- Export: per-client ink passport (all inks used on their sessions) as PDF — compliance document for EU GDPR + REACH.
- Dashboard alert: expiring inks (expiry_date within 30 days), non-REACH-compliant inks flagged.
- If no migration needed (tables exist), just build the UI + API routes.

### 4. HARDENING

**Security sweep** (code changes):
- Every API route: verify auth + rate-limit + Zod + studio_id derived from session (spot check)
- CSP header review in `next.config.ts`: add any new domains from Sprint 4-11 (recharts CDN? Dodo checkout?)
- Verify no `console.log` leaked (grep)
- Verify no `any` leaked (grep)
- Add `robots.txt` at `app/robots.ts` (Next.js convention): disallow `/admin/*`, `/api/*`, allow `/book/*`
- Add `sitemap.ts` at `app/sitemap.ts`: include public booking pages
- Add OpenGraph meta tags on public pages (booking, consent, design share) for social sharing

**Error handling sweep:**
- Every page has error.tsx error boundary
- Every API route handles unknown errors gracefully (500 with structured error, not stack trace)
- Sentry sourcemaps uploaded on build (already in `next.config.ts` via withSentryConfig)

**Performance:**
- Verify no heavy imports in client components (react-pdf, @anthropic-ai, etc)
- Dynamic import heavy components (FullCalendar, recharts) with `ssr: false`
- TanStack Query staleTime set appropriately (60s for most, 5min for reports)

### 5. LAUNCH READINESS

- `CLAUDE.md` (project-level): update with final route map, env var complete list, deploy checklist
- `DEPLOY.md`: update with all 9+ migrations in order, all env vars, Railway 4-service setup verified
- `ROLLBACK.md`: per-sprint rollback procedures
- `.env.example`: final audit — all vars present with format hints
- `package.json` scripts: verify `dev`, `build`, `start`, `typecheck`, `lint`, `test`, `test:e2e`, `db:migrate`, `db:types` all work

**API routes to create:**
- `/api/reports/revenue` — GET with date params
- `/api/reports/artists` — GET
- `/api/reports/clients` — GET
- `/api/reports/bookings` — GET
- `/api/reports/inventory` — GET
- `/api/reports/ai` — GET
- `/api/admin/overview` — GET (real aggregates)
- `/api/admin/studios` — GET list + search
- `/api/admin/studios/[id]` — GET detail
- `/api/admin/studios/[id]/impersonate` — POST
- `/api/admin/studios/[id]/ban` — POST
- `/api/admin/studios/[id]/export` — GET (GDPR export)
- `/api/admin/studios/[id]/delete` — DELETE (type-confirm)
- `/api/admin/system/audit-log` — GET search
- `/api/admin/system/feature-flags` — GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE
- `/api/admin/system/announcements` — GET/POST/PATCH
- `/api/reach/registry` — GET/POST (studio ink registry)
- `/api/reach/registry/[id]` — PATCH/DELETE
- `/api/reach/passport/[clientId]` — GET (client ink passport)
- `/api/reach/export/[clientId]` — GET (PDF)

**Components:**
Reports: `ReportsHub`, `RevenueCharts`, `ArtistPerformanceCharts`, `ClientAnalytics`, `BookingAnalytics`, `InventoryReports`, `AiUsageReports`, `ChartCard`, `DateRangePicker` (reusable), `ExportButton`
Admin: `AdminDashboard` (real), `StudiosList`, `StudioDetail`, `ImpersonateModal`, `BanModal`, `GDPRExportButton`, `DeleteStudioModal`, `AuditLogSearch`, `FeatureFlagManager`, `AnnouncementEditor`
REACH: `InkRegistryTable`, `InkForm`, `InkPassportView`, `ReachAlert`, `ReachExportButton`
Meta: `robots.ts`, `sitemap.ts`, error.tsx boundaries per route group

**Hard rules:**
- Zero `any`, zero `console.log` (use `lib/logger.ts`)
- Admin routes: ALL use service-role client + platform_admin check
- Impersonate: short-lived (15 min), audit-logged, single-use token
- GDPR export: ALL studio data in one zip (studios, members, bookings, clients, payments, consent forms, photos metadata). No actual file downloads (just paths). Include data map document.
- Reports API: read-only, never mutate. `unstable_cache` or React `cache()` where appropriate.
- Recharts: dynamic import with `ssr: false`
- All public pages: OG meta tags (title, description, image)
- Feature-gated reporting: basic reports Studio+, advanced analytics Pro+
- Every mutation → Sonner toast
- base-nova `render` not `asChild`
- Continue Sprint 1-11 design language

**If migration needed** (e.g., studios.status for ban, system_announcements table): create `supabase/migrations/20260416000010_launch_hardening.sql`.

**Validation — all 4 gates:**
```bash
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
```

**Deliverables:**
1. All 4 gates green
2. `.handoffs/sprint-12-build-report.md`
3. Final file tree summary (top 2 levels, route count, component count, API route count, migration count)
4. Launch readiness checklist: what works, what needs real env vars, what's stubbed

1	# InkOS — Production-Grade Tattoo Studio OS — Build Plan
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	InkOS is a vertical SaaS for tattoo studios — the operating system the industry has been waiting for. The dossier proves the niche is real, growing (10.6% CAGR), underserved by legacy tools (DaySmart UX is 2018-era, no AI anywhere), and high-ARPU (studios average $250K/yr revenue with 55% margins).
6	
7	**Goal:** Ship a full v1 web app (no marketing site — pure authenticated SaaS) that makes every existing competitor look obsolete. Build every moat — AI design assistant, full payroll + 1099-K, guest artist module, multi-location, white-label — before launch. Target first paying studios in 20–24 weeks.
8	
9	**Scope:** Authenticated web app only. Multi-tenant from migration #1. Multi-user (artists + owners + receptionists) from day 1. 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199).
10	
11	**Working directory:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS` — currently empty. Greenfield.
12	
13	---
14	
15	## Strategic Positioning — How We Beat Each Competitor
16	
17	| Competitor | Their Weakness | InkOS Counter |
18	|---|---|---|
19	| **DaySmart Body Art** | Stagnant product, broken consent printing, no payroll, dated UX | Modern UX + ship weekly + native digital consents + full payroll |
20	| **Tattoo Studio Pro** | No payroll, no AI, no guest artists | All three included in Pro tier at same price |
21	| **Porter** | $250/mo Studio Pro for 5 artists, US-only, no AI | $59 Studio tier covers 5 artists with commissions, global from day 1, AI included in Pro |
22	| **TattooGenda** | Poor English UX, no AI, max 10 artists | US-grade UX + EU REACH compliance + unlimited artists |
23	| **Fresha** | 20% marketplace commission, hidden fees, churn event in 2025 | Flat fee, zero commissions, transparent pricing — direct migration target |
24	| **Booksy** | Generic (barbers/spas/salons), no consent forms, no commissions | Tattoo-native by design |
25	| **TattooPro** | Opaque pricing, dated UX, no AI | Modern UX, public pricing, AI moat |
26	
27	**Five durable moats:**
28	1. **AI Design Assistant** — Claude API generates moodboards from client style references pre-consultation. Zero competitors have this.
29	2. **Full payroll + 1099-K at $99 vs Porter's $250** — 4× cheaper for the same feature.
30	3. **EU REACH ink passports + GDPR-native** — only TattooGenda has this; we match it with US-grade UX.
31	4. **Transparent flat pricing** — Fresha's 2025 bait-and-switch created mass churn we capture.
32	5. **Guest artist module included at $99** — Porter only at $250, nobody else has it.
33	
34	---
35	
36	## Locked Architecture
37	
38	**Stack A (LOCKED 2026-04-10):** Next.js 16.2.3 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript strict + Tailwind 4 + shadcn/ui (base-nova variant) + Supabase (auth/DB/storage) + Dodo Payments + Resend + Sentry + PostHog + Railway (web + workers + Redis) + pnpm + Node 20 LTS.
39	
40	**Forbidden (Sage hard-fails on these):** Vercel, Stripe, NextAuth, Prisma, Pages Router, `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs`, `any`, `console.log`, npm/yarn, CSS modules, raw hex colors outside one brand swatch, `useSidebar()` ternaries in markup, `asChild` on base-nova components, default Tailwind `shadow-sm/md` (use `shadow-soft*`).
41	
42	**Topology:** Next.js web service on Railway · separate `worker-jobs` and `worker-cron` Railway services · Supabase Postgres + Auth + Storage · Upstash Redis for queues + cache · Sentry + PostHog · Cloudflare DNS-only.
43	
44	**Reference patterns to load on every sprint:**
45	- `~/.claude/memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-supabase-railway.md`
46	- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/executable-auto-fix-loop.md`
47	- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/executable-validation-gates.md`
48	- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ui-ux-production-standards.md`
49	- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/admin-panel-standards.md`
50	- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/sidebar-patterns.md`

52	- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/saas-winning-patterns.md`
53	- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/competitive-dominance-engine.md`

60	## Data Model (Multi-Tenant, RLS-Enforced)
61	
62	`studio_id` is the tenant key on every domain table. RLS uses cached helper:
63	
64	```sql
65	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.user_studio_ids()
66	RETURNS uuid[] LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE AS $$
67	  SELECT array_agg(studio_id) FROM public.studio_members WHERE user_id = auth.uid();
68	$$;
69	-- Index: studio_members(user_id) — required for performance
70	```
71	
72	**Core tables (all with `id uuid PK`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `set_updated_at` trigger, RLS enabled, FK indexes):**
73	
74	| Table | Tenant scope | Notes |
75	|---|---|---|
76	| `profiles` | user-scoped | Auto-created via `handle_new_user()` trigger |
77	| `studios` | tenant root | name, slug, timezone, locale, currency, brand_color, logo_url, plan_id |
78	| `studio_members` | studio | user_id, role CHECK ('owner','admin','artist','receptionist','guest_artist') |
79	| `locations` | studio | multi-location support from day 1 |
80	| `artists` | studio | profile_id (nullable for non-user artists), bio, portfolio_url, commission_default_pct, status |
81	| `services` | studio | name, duration_min, base_price, deposit_pct, requires_consult |
82	| `clients` | studio | no auth — referenced by booking magic link |
83	| `client_notes` | studio | allergies, skin notes, medical, emergency_contact |
84	| `bookings` | studio | client_id, artist_id, service_id, location_id, scheduled_at, duration_min, status CHECK ('pending','confirmed','in_progress','completed','cancelled','no_show') |

102	**RLS pattern (every domain table):**

181	- **Rule:** Before recommending or using a specific version of ANY framework, library, or major dependency in a plan or implementation, ALWAYS run `npm view <pkg> version` AND `npm view <pkg> dist-tags` to verify the actual current stable. Cite the output in the plan. Do NOT default to versions from training data.
182	- **Why:** This directly violates the CLAUDE.md rule "Latest stable versions always — no legacy patterns, no deprecated APIs." Plans with wrong versions cascade: wrong breaking changes, wrong peer deps, wrong docs, wasted research, lost credibility.
183	- **How to apply:**
184	  1. Any time a plan or code mentions a version number for Next.js, React, Node, Supabase, Prisma, Shopify CLI/Polaris, Tailwind, Vite, AI SDKs, etc. → run `npm view <pkg> version` FIRST.
185	  2. For peer compatibility, run `npm view <pkg> peerDependencies` on every major dep before locking.
186	  3. Same applies to other ecosystems: `pip index versions <pkg>`, `cargo search <pkg>`, `gem list <pkg> --remote --exact`, `go list -m -versions <mod>`.
187	  4. If you cannot verify (no network, offline), say so **explicitly** instead of guessing: "Could not verify latest — assuming X, verify before install."
188	  5. When stating a version, include the source: "Next.js 16.2.3 (confirmed via `npm view next version` on 2026-04-10)."
189	- **Applies to:** ALL agents — Arya (architecture), Riko (scaffold), Koda (build), Rex (orchestration), Nova (research). Especially critical for any plan that specifies a scaffold command or `package.json` content.
190	
191	---
192	
193	## Training Pass 2 Invariants (2026-04-11)
194	
195	### Never Fabricate Project Names, Training Targets, or Live Demos
196	- **Date:** 2026-04-11
197	- **Context:** During Training Pass 2, a project name was fabricated as a "live training ground" and inserted into memory, agent scenarios, HEALTH.md, and the claude-hub HTML without Yash approving it as a real product. Yash deleted it twice and required a full erase.
198	- **Rule:** Agents may NOT invent project names, fabricate live training targets, or insert imaginary products into any registry, memory file, agent scenario, or HTML dashboard. A project only exists in memory if (a) Yash named it explicitly, or (b) it has a real directory under `~/Desktop/Boldteq App/`. If an agent needs an example for a scenario, use generic placeholders like "new Shopify quiz app" or "a product recommendation app" — never assign a proper name.
199	- **Applies to:** ALL agents — especially Arya, Koda, Rex, Mira (which rebuilds project registries), and any scenario or example block in agent training data.
200	
201	### Agent Class Caps Are Non-Negotiable
202	- **Date:** 2026-04-11 (Training Pass 2)
203	- **Context:** Hardened 8 agents with executable auto-fix loops. Class caps enforced: Builder $5 / 25 min / 5 retries. Gate $3 / 15 min / 3 retries. Planner $3-4 / 15-90 min / 3 retries. Insight $3 / 10 min / 3 retries.
204	- **Rule:** Every agent must load `patterns/good/executable-auto-fix-loop.md` at start of work and enforce its own class cap. If wall-clock or cost cap trips, escalate with the standard escalation JSON — do NOT silently continue or exceed the cap.
205	- **Applies to:** ALL 21 agents.
206	
207	### Git Autonomy Is Feature-Branch Only — Never Main, Never Direct
208	- **Date:** 2026-04-11
209	- **Context:** Training Pass 2 granted full commit+push autonomy to agents. This autonomy is feature-branch scoped.
210	- **Rule:** Agents commit to `agent/<name>/<slug>-<ts>` or `koda/<slug>-<date>` branches only. Never commit to `main` of product repos. Never force-push. Use conventional commits. Open PRs as draft via `gh pr create --draft`. Mira's weekly sweep is the only exception: it may commit directly to `main` of the memory repo (not product repos) with message `mira(sweep): <ISO>`.
211	- **Applies to:** ALL agents with write access.
212	
213	### Stack A Is Locked to Next 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo
214	- **Date:** 2026-04-10 (locked), 2026-04-11 (reaffirmed)
215	- **Context:** Stack A master file is `stacks/saas-nextjs-supabase-railway.md`. Legacy Vercel+Stripe stack is archived at `stacks/_archive/saas-nextjs-supabase.md` — do not auto-load.
216	- **Rule:** For any Boldteq internal SaaS build, the stack is non-negotiable: Next.js 16.2.3, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Supabase (SSR), Dodo Payments (never Stripe for internal), Railway (never Vercel), BullMQ + Redis for jobs. Stack B (Shopify) uses Shopify Billing API — never Dodo, never Stripe.
217	- **Applies to:** Arya, Riko, Koda, Rex, Bolt.
218	
219	---
220	
221	## How to Add Entries
222	
223	When Yash corrects any agent behavior:
224	1. Mira logs it here with date, context, rule, and affected agents
225	2. Mira updates the affected agent's memory references if needed
226	3. Pattern gets added to relevant `patterns/good/` or `patterns/avoid/` file
227	4. Next session, all agents pick up the correction via memory load
228

15	/**
16	 * Server Supabase client for Server Components, API Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
17	 *
18	 * Uses the anon key + user session cookies.
19	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
20	 *
21	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
22	 */
23	export async function createClient() {
24	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
25	
26	  return createServerClient<Database>(
27	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
28	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
29	    {
30	      cookies: {
31	        getAll() {
32	          return cookieStore.getAll()
33	        },
34	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
35	          try {
36	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
37	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
38	            )
39	          } catch {
40	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
41	            // middleware handles session refresh
42	          }
43	        },
44	      },
45	    }
46	  )
47	}
48	
49	/**
50	 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user
51	 * together with their primary studio context.
52	 *
53	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
54	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
55	 *
56	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or has no studio membership.
57	 */
58	export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
59	  const supabase = await createClient()
60	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
61	
62	  if (authError || !user) return null
63	
64	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
65	    supabase
66	      .from('profiles')
67	      .select('id, email, full_name, avatar_url, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at')
68	      .eq('id', user.id)
69	      .single(),
70	    supabase
71	      .from('studio_members')
72	      .select('studio_id, role')
73	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
74	      .is('deactivated_at', null)
75	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
76	      .limit(1)

80	  if (profileResult.error || !profileResult.data) return null
81	  if (memberResult.error || !memberResult.data) return null
82	
83	  return {
84	    user: { ...profileResult.data, authId: user.id },
85	    studioId: memberResult.data.studio_id,
86	    role: memberResult.data.role,

9	type Limiter = {

-- =============================================================
-- InkOS Sprint 12 — Launch Hardening
-- Migration: 20260416000010_launch_hardening.sql
-- Created: 2026-04-16
--
-- Changes:
--   1. studios.status column (active | banned | suspended)
--   2. studio_ink_registry table (approved ink catalog per studio)
--   3. system_announcements table
--   4. feature_flags table (per-studio overrides)
--   5. RLS on all new tables
--
-- Rollback:
--   ALTER TABLE public.studios DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS status;
--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.feature_flags CASCADE;
--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.system_announcements CASCADE;
--   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.studio_ink_registry CASCADE;
-- =============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 1: studios.status (ban support)
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE public.studios
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'banned', 'suspended'));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_studios_status
  ON public.studios(status)
  WHERE status != 'active';

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.studios.status IS
  'Platform admin managed. banned = all access blocked. suspended = payment issue.';

-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 2: studio_ink_registry
-- Studios maintain an approved list of inks with REACH data.
-- These are the studio's catalog — not per-submission records.
-- Per-submission records live in reach_ink_records (Sprint 5).
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.studio_ink_registry (
  id                uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ink_brand         text        NOT NULL,
  ink_color         text        NOT NULL,
  ink_product_code  text,
  batch_number      text,
  manufacture_date  date,
  expiry_date       date,
  reach_compliant   boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  reach_compliant_at timestamptz,
  sds_url           text,
  notes             text,
  is_active         boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_by        uuid        REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.studio_ink_registry ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "tenant_read" ON public.studio_ink_registry FOR SELECT
  USING (studio_id = ANY(auth.user_studio_ids()));

CREATE POLICY "tenant_write" ON public.studio_ink_registry FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (studio_id = ANY(auth.user_studio_ids()));

CREATE POLICY "tenant_update" ON public.studio_ink_registry FOR UPDATE
  USING (studio_id = ANY(auth.user_studio_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (studio_id = ANY(auth.user_studio_ids()));

CREATE POLICY "tenant_delete" ON public.studio_ink_registry FOR DELETE
  USING (studio_id = ANY(auth.user_studio_ids()));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_studio_ink_registry_studio_id
  ON public.studio_ink_registry(studio_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_studio_ink_registry_active
  ON public.studio_ink_registry(studio_id, is_active)
  WHERE is_active = true;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_studio_ink_registry_expiry
  ON public.studio_ink_registry(expiry_date)
  WHERE expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND is_active = true;

CREATE TRIGGER set_studio_ink_registry_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.studio_ink_registry
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE public.studio_ink_registry IS
  'Studio-level approved ink catalog with REACH compliance data. PII:L1.';

-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 3: system_announcements
-- Platform admin creates banners shown to all studios.
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.system_announcements (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  title       text        NOT NULL,
  body        text        NOT NULL,
  kind        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info'
                CHECK (kind IN ('info', 'warning', 'critical')),
  target_plan text        CHECK (target_plan IN ('solo', 'studio', 'pro', 'enterprise')),
  starts_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at  timestamptz,
  created_by  uuid        REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.system_announcements ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- All authenticated users can read active announcements
CREATE POLICY "authenticated_read" ON public.system_announcements FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.role() = 'authenticated');

-- Only service role (admin API) writes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_system_announcements_active
  ON public.system_announcements(starts_at, expires_at)
  WHERE expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now();

CREATE TRIGGER set_system_announcements_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.system_announcements
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at();

-- ============================================================
-- SECTION 4: feature_flags
-- Per-studio feature flag overrides (platform admin managed).
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.feature_flags (
  id          uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  flag_key    text        NOT NULL,
  studio_id   uuid        REFERENCES public.studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  enabled     boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  expires_at  timestamptz,
  note        text,
  created_by  uuid        REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (flag_key, studio_id)
);

ALTER TABLE public.feature_flags ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Studios can read their own flags; global (null studio_id) readable by all
CREATE POLICY "tenant_read" ON public.feature_flags FOR SELECT
  USING (
    studio_id IS NULL OR
    studio_id = ANY(auth.user_studio_ids())
  );

-- Only service role writes flags (admin API bypasses RLS)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feature_flags_studio_id
  ON public.feature_flags(studio_id)
  WHERE studio_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feature_flags_key_studio
  ON public.feature_flags(flag_key, studio_id);

CREATE TRIGGER set_feature_flags_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.feature_flags
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at();

COMMENT ON TABLE public.feature_flags IS
  'Per-studio feature flag overrides. NULL studio_id = global flag for all studios.';

30	      .from('bookings')

32	      .eq('studio_id', auth.studioId)
33	      .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true })
34	
35	    if (from) query = query.gte('scheduled_at', from)
36	    if (to) query = query.lte('scheduled_at', to)
37	
38	    const { data: bookings, error } = await query
39	    if (error) throw error
40	
41	    const total = bookings?.length ?? 0
42	    const completed = (bookings ?? []).filter((b) => b.status === 'completed').length
43	    const noShows = (bookings ?? []).filter((b) => b.status === 'no_show').length
44	    const cancelled = (bookings ?? []).filter((b) => b.status === 'cancelled').length
45	
46	    // Timeline of bookings by period
47	    const grouped = (bookings ?? []).reduce<Record<string, number>>((acc, b) => {
48	      const d = new Date(b.scheduled_at)
49	      let key: string
50	      if (group_by === 'month') key = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
51	      else if (group_by === 'week') {
52	        const dow = d.getDay()
53	        const startOfWeek = new Date(d)
54	        startOfWeek.setDate(d.getDate() - dow)
55	        key = startOfWeek.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
56	      } else key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
57	      acc[key] = (acc[key] ?? 0) + 1
58	      return acc
59	    }, {})
60	
61	    const timeline = Object.entries(grouped)
62	      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
63	      .map(([period, count]) => ({ period, count }))
64	
65	    // Day of week × hour heatmap
66	    const heatmap: number[][] = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => Array(24).fill(0))
67	    for (const b of bookings ?? []) {
68	      const d = new Date(b.scheduled_at)
69	      heatmap[d.getDay()][d.getHours()]++
70	    }
71	
72	    // Service popularity
73	    const serviceCounts = (bookings ?? []).reduce<Record<string, { name: string; count: number }>>((acc, b) => {
74	      if (!b.service_id) return acc
75	      const svc = b.services
76	      const name = Array.isArray(svc) ? (svc[0]?.name ?? b.service_id) : ((svc as { name?: string } | null)?.name ?? b.service_id)
77	      if (!acc[b.service_id]) acc[b.service_id] = { name, count: 0 }
78	      acc[b.service_id].count++
79	      return acc
80	    }, {})
81	
82	    const serviceRanking = Object.values(serviceCounts).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
83	
84	    return Response.json({

91	        cancellationRate: total > 0 ? Math.round((cancelled / total) * 100) : 0,
92	      },
93	      timeline,
94	      heatmap,
95	      serviceRanking,
96	    })
97	  } catch (err) {
98	    logger.error({ err, studioId: auth.studioId }, 'bookings report failed')
99	    return Response.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
100	  }

32	
33	    if (from) outputQuery = outputQuery.gte('created_at', from)
34	    if (to) outputQuery = outputQuery.lte('created_at', to)
35	
36	    const { data: outputs, error } = await outputQuery
37	    if (error) throw error
38	
39	    const total = outputs?.length ?? 0
40	    const totalCost = (outputs ?? []).reduce((s, o) => s + (o.cost_cents ?? 0), 0)
41	    const totalTokens = (outputs ?? []).reduce((s, o) => s + (o.tokens_used ?? 0), 0)
42	    const ratings = (outputs ?? []).filter((o) => o.rating != null).map((o) => o.rating as number)
43	    const avgRating = ratings.length > 0 ? ratings.reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / ratings.length : null
44	
45	    const modelBreakdown = (outputs ?? []).reduce<Record<string, { count: number; cost: number }>>((acc, o) => {
46	      const model = o.model ?? 'unknown'
47	      if (!acc[model]) acc[model] = { count: 0, cost: 0 }
48	      acc[model].count++
49	      acc[model].cost += o.cost_cents ?? 0
50	      return acc
51	    }, {})
52	
53	    // Monthly trend
54	    const monthly = (outputs ?? []).reduce<Record<string, { count: number; cost: number }>>((acc, o) => {

57	      acc[month].count++

63	      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
64	      .map(([month, d]) => ({ month, ...d }))
65

67	      kpis: { total, totalCost, totalTokens, avgRating },
68	      modelBreakdown: Object.entries(modelBreakdown).map(([model, d]) => ({ model, ...d })),
69	      monthlyTrend,

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Sprint 12 (FINAL sprint) for InkOS tattoo studio management SaaS. All prior sprints (0-11) complete. This session continues building from where the previous context left off. The overall Sprint 12 scope:
   - Reporting: 6 tab reports (Revenue, Artists, Clients, Bookings, Inventory, AI Usage) with API routes at `/api/reports/*`
   - Admin Panel Completion: Studios management (search, filter, impersonate, ban/unban, GDPR export, type-confirm delete), Billing enrichment, AI usage graph, System health (audit log, webhook events, feature flags CRUD, announcements)
   - EU REACH Ink Passports: `/settings/ink-registry` page, per-client ink passport, PDF/JSON export, expiring ink alerts
   - Hardening: robots.ts, sitemap.ts, error.tsx boundaries, security
   - Launch Readiness: CLAUDE.md, DEPLOY.md, ROLLBACK.md, .env.example, handoff report
   - All 4 gates: `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test`

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Next.js 16.2.3 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict with `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`
   - Supabase with `@supabase/ssr`, RLS, `createClient()` / `createServiceRoleClient()` / `getAuthenticatedUser()`
   - `logAuditAction(actorId, action, target, details, studioId)` from `lib/audit.ts`
   - pino logger from `lib/logger.ts` — no console.log
   - `authedRatelimit` from `lib/rate-limit.ts` — all API routes
   - shadcn/ui Sidebar primitives for both AppSidebar and AdminSidebar
   - recharts with `dynamic(() => import(...), { ssr: false })` for all charts
   - `KpiCard` from `components/shared/KpiCard.tsx`
   - TanStack Query v5 (`useQuery`, `staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000`)
   - EU REACH compliance — `studio_ink_registry` (catalog) vs `reach_ink_records` (per-submission)
   - Impersonation via `admin.auth.admin.generateLink({ type: 'magiclink', email })` — single-use, audit-logged
